chunks: Abu Jaʿfar عليه السلام, when it was the Day of ʿArafah, would not turn away a beggar.

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Abu Jaʿfar, the Imam being described in this report
key_terms.سَائِلًا: a petitioner or beggar asking for assistance
key_terms.لَمْ يَرُدَّ: he would not turn away or refuse
key_terms.يَوْمُ عَرَفَةَ: the Day of ʿArafah, a sacred day during hajj

ai.seo_question: How did Abu Jaʿfar عليه السلام treat beggars on the Day of ʿArafah?
ai.summary: This report describes the practice of Abu Jaʿfar عليه السلام on the Day of ʿArafah: he would not refuse anyone who asked him. It highlights generosity and compassion on a sacred day associated with worship, mercy, and nearness to Allah.
